# Amr Abu-Talleb

> Creative Director with 13 years across brand, campaigns and digital products. He has led teams of up to 25 people across 8 markets and hired more than 50. Open to Creative Director roles in Europe, remote or on-site, and to Head of Design and Design Director roles where brand and product sit together.

Amr trained in calligraphy and typography and works in English and Arabic. He sets the creative direction and the review standard, builds the team behind it, and stays close to the work. He also prototypes in code with AI, from brief to a live staging build in days, not sprints.

Contact: hello@amrabutalleb.com · LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/abutalleb/ · He replies within 24 hours.

## Case studies

- [Overpowered](https://amrabutalleb.com/work/overpowered): Creative Director at a creative and digital agency. Grew the team from six to about twenty-five in seven months, set the positioning with the CEO and directed the new identity.
- [SPLT](https://amrabutalleb.com/work/split): turned an online shop brief into a fitness platform built around its trainers. One app and three dashboards for four roles.
- [Bay Area Trips](https://amrabutalleb.com/work/bay-area-trips): product strategy and design for a US travel and local-discovery platform, taken from idea to a live website and app with a build team of about thirty.
- [TapTools](https://amrabutalleb.com/work/taptools): senior product designer on a live analytics platform. User-reported issues fell 23% within 60 days of launch.
- [Agfin](https://amrabutalleb.com/work/agfin): rebuilt an Australian financial consultant's website as a story-led sales funnel. Client wins rose 12% in the first month with no paid advertising.
- [As Within, So Without](https://amrabutalleb.com/work/steve-hodel): a 212-page book designed for New York Times bestselling author Steve Hodel, with more than 130 images.
